title: Low-level source error reporting helpers

scope.rationale: The low-level corruption, misuse, and cannot-open helpers share one source-location logger and return the unchanged primary result code for propagation.

external_source_responsibilities: Process log callback and pinned source ID
dependencies.caller_closure: The common reporter and all three active-profile convenience helpers are assigned together.

inputs: Primary result code, source line, and static error category
outputs: Unchanged primary result code after optional log delivery
contracts.ownership: Borrowed category and pinned source-ID slices; formatter owns only transient rendering storage.
contracts.state_and_results: With or without an installed log callback, return codes remain CORRUPT, MISUSE, or CANTOPEN exactly. The log includes category, source line, and ten-character check-in prefix.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: May invoke the process log callback through the native formatter; no database lock or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Absent callback or log formatting allocation failure does not change the propagated result code.

representation_differences: Typed formatter arguments replace source variadic sqlite3_log while preserving the rendered message fields.

oracle.protocol: Install a process log callback, invoke each helper at fixed lines, compare result code and rendered category/line/check-in prefix, then repeat with logging disabled.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact primary codes and stable message fields; the pinned check-in prefix is exact.

assurance.oom: Formatter OOM may suppress a log but never changes the returned code.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; process logging synchronization is delegated to the existing callback owner.
assurance.malformed_input: Internal helpers require a valid static category; line and result are passed through as signed C integers.
assurance.continuation: Logging has no connection error-state mutation and callers continue propagating the returned code.
assurance.performance: One bounded formatter invocation only when a callback is installed.

integration.native_call_path: Native low-level owners can invoke the helpers through the exported root module and receive exact result identity.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Yes. No no-op low-level reporting substitute remains.

independent_review.notes: Pinned-C differential, assurance, and independent review remain open.

known_blockers: Connect additional low-level call sites as their source owners are ported.
Complete assurance and independent fidelity review.

implementation_spans: Complete pinned main.c reporter and three active convenience bodies
Native logging formatter, process callback owner, pinned source ID, and error-state tests
callers: Low-level corruption, misuse, and cannot-open detection sites
assertions_branches_cleanup: Installed/absent callback, all categories, source line, check-in prefix, and exact result identity reviewed
upstream_tests: Upstream log callback and error breakpoint tests
